prompt:
Wide 16:9 background illustration for a mystery adventure video game, no characters.
Scene: a snowy garden of a small wooden Japanese house in a snowy town on a bright, clear, windless winter afternoon, deep blue sky, long blue shadows on the snow. In the sunny middle of the garden stand two snowmen side by side, both made of two plain snowballs with small charcoal eyes and charcoal buttons, NO nose, NO carrot, NO hat, NO mouth: the one on the right is whole and wears NOTHING around its neck (no scarf at all); the one on the left has lost its head, which lies on the snow beside its round body together with a dark knitted scarf (the only scarf in the picture). A thermometer hangs in the shade under the eaves (its dial blank, no numbers). A few oval boot prints of children's shoes and two small snow shovels; absolutely NO animal paw prints and NO animal tracks anywhere. Peaceful, bright, a small mystery.
Accent colour of this case: warm sunlight yellow #FFD84A for the sunlight.
Art style: bold graphic-novel illustration, confident black ink linework, flat cel shading with subtle halftone screentone dots in the shadows, limited palette (ink navy #0B0D12, bone white #F2EFE6, cold teal shadows #1B3A44) plus the single accent colour given in this prompt, theatrical lighting, stylish and elegant, gentle, warm and quietly curious mystery mood, cozy rather than unsettling, suitable for children. Polished key-visual quality for a premium mystery adventure video game.
Composition: the key subjects are kept inside the central 60% of the width so the image can be
cropped to a narrower frame, with clean readable depth and atmospheric perspective. No person.
Strict constraints: NO gore, NO blood, NO wounds, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO numerals, NO writing of any kind, NO captions, NO speech bubbles, NO logos, NO watermark, NO signature, NO frame, NO border.

One panel of a wordless four-panel story sequence for a mystery adventure video game for all ages.

Scene: early afternoon in the same sunny snowy garden. Both snowmen are plain snowballs with charcoal eyes and buttons, NO nose, NO carrot, NO hat, NO mouth. The snowman's neck has grown thin like a waist and its round head has rolled off onto the snow beside the body, the dark scarf lying loose. Next to it, the other snowman without a scarf still stands whole. No people; only a few oval boot prints of children's shoes from the morning, absolutely NO animal paw prints and NO animal tracks. Long shadows; the sun in warm sunlight yellow (the spot colour). A small, gentle, slightly comic surprise, not sad.

Format: ONE single wordless (silent) manga / graphic-novel panel that fills the whole canvas edge to edge: full bleed, no panel border, no gutter, no multi-panel page layout. Art style: bold confident black ink brush and pen linework, crisp cross-hatching and printed dot screentone (halftone) for all greys and shadows, on warm off-white paper (#F2EAD8). STRICTLY MONOCHROME: everything is black ink and neutral grey screentone on the cream paper EXCEPT for ONE single spot accent colour, warm sunlight yellow (#FFD84A), used sparingly only where the scene says. No other hue anywhere: no skin tones, no wood or brick colours, no blue or orange sky, no green leaves, no orange carrot noses. Clear, readable composition, strong silhouettes, deep blacks, gentle, warm and curious mood suitable for children, a little mysterious but never scary. People are drawn from behind or as silhouettes, or only their hands; faces are NEVER shown, no front or three-quarter view of anyone's face. Premium published graphic-novel quality.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OF ANY KIND ANYWHERE: no lettering, no speech balloons, no thought bubbles, no caption boxes, no narration boxes, no sound-effect lettering or onomatopoeia (neither Japanese kana/kanji nor Latin letters), no numbers or numerals (clocks, screens and dials are blank), no signs or signage, no labels, no brand names, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no panel number. Use only pictures, lines, tone and light. NO gore, NO blood, NO wounds, NO injuries shown, NO dead bodies, NO nudity, NO bare skin beyond hands, NO frightening faces.
